notes: This book is a sequel/reimagining of Humpty Dumpty focusing on overcoming fear and resilience after trauma — key emotional vocabulary (scared, brave) is as important as the physical story vocabulary. The existing activity_images already include wall, egg, bird, wings, sky, nest, tree, paper, glue, binoculars, ladder, cast — several of these overlap well with the story. Consider supplementing the AAC board with 'wings' and 'sky' from existing assets as bonus discussion words. 'Paper airplane' is central to the plot and may need a custom image if the Boardmaker library does not have it. 'Crack' on an egg specifically may need a custom image — search 'cracked egg' for best results.
